source.title: Monza magic and a Monaco dream — Leclerc's Ferrari moments
source.locator: Claim-specific Hall of Fame paragraph or section recorded in each claim.evidence.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 source inspected on 2026-10-24; per-claim locators record relevant sections. Independent publisher corroboration and EN/UK human review pending.

claims.en: Leclerc took his first Formula 1 Grand Prix victory in Belgium in 2019 while driving for Ferrari.
claims.uk: Леклер здобув свою першу перемогу на Гран-прі Формули-1 у Бельгії 2019 року за Ferrari.

evidence.locator: Article section 'First victory (2019)': Belgian Grand Prix win at Spa-Francorchamps for Ferrari.
FIA 2019 Belgian GP race report, opening paragraph and race classification: first win at Spa for Ferrari.

claims.en: Leclerc won his home Monaco Grand Prix in 2024.
claims.uk: Леклер виграв домашній Гран-прі Монако у 2024 році.

evidence.locator: Article section 'First Monaco victory (2024)': pole, race lead and victory at his home Grand Prix.
FIA 2024 Monaco GP race report, opening paragraph and P1 classification: home victory for Ferrari.

claims.en: Leclerc made his Formula 1 debut with Sauber in 2018.
claims.uk: Леклер дебютував у Формулі-1 з Sauber у 2018 році.

evidence.locator: Article section 'First pole position (2019)': joined F1 with Sauber two years after Ferrari Driver Academy in 2016.
FIA 2018 Mexican GP media kit, Sauber driver Charles Leclerc bio: F1 debut 2018 Australia (Sauber).

claims.en: Leclerc earned his first Formula 1 pole position in Bahrain in 2019 during his second race for Ferrari.
claims.uk: Леклер здобув свій перший поул у Формулі-1 у Бахрейні 2019 року під час другого Гран-прі за Ferrari.

evidence.locator: Article section 'First pole position (2019)': Bahrain qualifying, second race with Ferrari.
FIA 2019 Bahrain GP Saturday press conference, interviewer to Leclerc: first F1 pole in his second Ferrari Grand Prix.

claims.en: Leclerc won the 2019 Italian Grand Prix at Monza for Ferrari one week after his first victory in Belgium.
claims.uk: Леклер виграв Гран-прі Італії 2019 року в Монці за Ferrari через тиждень після першої перемоги в Бельгії.

evidence.locator: Article section 'First win at Monza (2019)': Ferrari victory following Belgian Grand Prix.
FIA 2019 Italian GP race report, opening paragraph: second successive win and Ferrari victory at Monza.
